text:
emma_cs: Quick ping — VegaCorp renewal ready but procurement flagged a billing-entity change. They want the PO to be issued to a different legal entity before payment.
raj_sales: Got it. Do they have the new legal name and tax ID?
emma_cs: Yes. New entity: Vega Holdings UK Ltd, VAT GB999999999. They attached vendor paperwork.
linda_legal: Heads-up: current SOW was signed by a director of the old entity. We either need a re-signed SOW from Vega Holdings UK Ltd or an explicit delegation of signing authority from the old entity.
oliver_finance: If they want invoicing to a different entity, billing ops needs PO + vendor code update. Can procurement issue a PO without the new signature in place?
emma_cs: Procurement says they will only issue the PO once legal confirms signer mapping. So it's circular.
raj_sales: I'll ask the customer for a delegated signatory with confirmed authority and email. If they provide delegation on letterhead we can accept that plus the PO.
linda_legal: Delegation letter acceptable if it names the delegate, specifies scope (e.g., "authority to sign commercial agreements up to X"), and is signed & dated. Ask them to route from legal or finance.
emma_cs: Sharing our delegation template: `https://redwood.internal/templates/delegation-letter.docx`
raj_sales: Pinged procurement and legal contact at Vega. Requested: scanned delegation letter + new PO number (PO must reference "Vega Holdings UK Ltd"). Asked for reply by EOD UK.
odocusign_bot: docusign-bot: SOW VegaCorp-renewal-v2 sent to james@vegacorp.com at 2025-04-16T09:12:00Z
emma_cs: Note: envelope was sent to James at the old entity already. We should pause that envelope until we confirm whether to accept a delegated signer.
linda_legal: Void the existing envelope to avoid partial execution tying the SOW to wrong entity. I'll draft required wording for the delegation letter.
oliver_finance: Finance note: if PO comes in with a different VAT treatment we may need tax coordination and possibly a credit/reissue flow. Flagging tax ops.
raj_sales: Vega procurement replied: "We can sign with Sarah Miles (sarah@vegaholdings.co.uk). We'll issue PO VH-2025-998 by EOD BST."
emma_cs: Sarah's title is Head of Finance per LinkedIn. I'll ask for a delegation letter on company letterhead and that they cc legal/finance on the PO email.
linda_legal: If delegation arrives, ensure it lists full legal entity name, tax/VAT ID, effective date range, and explicit signature authority. I'll review immediately.
odocusign_bot: docusign-bot: Envelope VG-998 voided by emma_cs at 2025-04-16T10:04:00Z
emma_cs: Voided the old envelope and told Vega procurement to pause.
raj_sales: Also requested confirmation of payment terms (they requested Net30 under new entity).
oliver_finance: Net30 acceptable; will update AR calendar. But note cash timing will shift.
emma_cs: Vega uploaded PO and delegation letter to DocSend: `https://docsend.com/view/vegacorp-renewal-attachments`
linda_legal: Reviewing delegation: it states "delegated authority to sign commercial agreements up to 250,000" and is signed by CFO of the legacy entity. Language looks sufficient. Approving.
oliver_finance: PO VH-2025-998 received. Submitted vendor code update request to billing ops (vh-uk-03).
emma_cs: Resending SOW to sarah@vegaholdings.co.uk with billing entity updated. Please confirm when signed.
odocusign_bot: docusign-bot: New envelope VG-999 sent to sarah@vegaholdings.co.uk at 2025-04-16T11:22:00Z
raj_sales: Thanks — I'll monitor. Procurement also noted they will attach the delegation letter to the PO email thread.
oliver_finance: Once signed, finance will invoice Vega Holdings UK Ltd with PO VH-2025-998. If VAT treatment differs we'll loop tax ops.
linda_legal: After signature, I'll append the delegation letter to the contract record and confirm legal closure.
emma_cs: Sarah completed the signature at 2025-04-16T12:01:14Z.
odocusign_bot: docusign-bot: Envelope VG-999 completed by sarah@vegaholdings.co.uk at 2025-04-16T12:01:14Z
oliver_finance: Invoice issued against VH-2025-998 to Vega Holdings UK Ltd. Vendor code VH-UK-03. Amount matches renewal.
raj_sales: Awesome — please leave a short note in Gainsight so onboarding team sees the entity change for future billing.
emma_cs: Done. Uploaded signed SOW + delegation letter to the customer record and added Gainsight note summarizing the entity cutover and Net30 terms. Closing thread :tada:
